item.title: Weekly Jigsaw
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: A fresh AI-generated picture every Monday. Each piece you place is a git commit. The puzzle’s solving history is the git log. Sign in with GitHub to play. The “type a code at github.com/login/device” flow runs entirely in your browser; no server holds your token.
item.content:encoded:
A fresh AI-generated picture every Monday. Each piece you place is a git commit. The puzzle’s solving history is the git log.

Sign in with GitHub to play. The “type a code at github.com/login/device” flow runs entirely in your browser; no server holds your token.
